_meta.title: Greaves Cotton — FY25 actuals (market anchors)
_meta.note: Greaves reports 4 segments: Engines / Electric Mobility / Cables & Levers / Others. The Engines segment combines Automotive Engines + Non-Automotive (Gensets) + Farm + Spares — Power Gen revenue is NOT isolated. Numbers below are CONSOLIDATED unless marked standalone.

rows.label: Total revenue (consolidated)
rows.source: Greaves AR FY24-25, p.18 (Consolidated Financial Performance) / p.272 (Segment note)
rows.notes: FY24: ₹2,633.19 Cr. +11% YoY. New business initiatives = 63% of total consolidated revenue.

rows.label: EBITDA (consolidated)
rows.notes: Greaves AR does not disclose EBITDA directly. Needs computation from P&L + D&A; skipped for now.

rows.label: Net profit / (loss) (consolidated)
rows.notes: Loss after tax. FY24 loss was ₹367.27 Cr — significant improvement. EPS ₹2.51 (FY24: -₹5.83) — includes exceptional items.

rows.label: Power Gen segment revenue
rows.notes: Engines segment (₹1,795.65 Cr) bundles Automotive + Non-Automotive (Gensets) + Farm + Spares. Power Gen alone is a subset — AR narrative mentions CPCB IV+ genset launches and data-centre fire-fighting engine demand but no ₹ figure.

rows.label: Engines segment revenue (consolidated)
rows.notes: FY24: ₹1,614.67 Cr. +11.2% YoY. Segment result (profit) ₹305.43 Cr — 17.0% margin. Covers Automotive + Non-Automotive + Farm + Spares.

rows.label: Industrial engine revenue
rows.notes: Not separated. Narrative: growth in firefighting (FMUL engines), agri, construction, components; marine segment growing.

rows.label: Retail / Aftermarket revenue
rows.notes: Greaves Retail is a separate business unit but revenue rolls up within 'Others' segment (₹222.59 Cr) — not strictly comparable to KOEL D&AM.

rows.label: Water Management / Pumps revenue
rows.source: Not applicable — Greaves has no WMS business
rows.notes: Greaves does not operate in water / pump business.

rows.label: Overseas revenue (consolidated)
rows.notes: FY24: ₹182.43 Cr. Small export base (6.8% of consolidated revenue). Africa + SAARC + ME growing; SEA + Turkey weak.

rows.label: Gensets sold
rows.notes: Not disclosed. AR mentions industry-wide genset market volumes fell 8% but value grew 10% (shift to high-value HHP). Assembled entirely in-house at Talegaon plant.

rows.label: Avg realization per unit (implied)
rows.notes: Neither numerator (Power Gen revenue) nor denominator (units) disclosed.

rows.label: Genset service network locations
rows.source: Greaves AR FY24-25, p.18 (Engineering Business narrative)
rows.notes: Reported as '120+ locations'. 24/7 support, remote monitoring via 'Greaves 1' app.

rows.label: CPCB IV+ share of Power Gen revenue
rows.notes: Narrative: CPCB IV+ compliant range launched in FY25; FY25 saw CPCB II pre-buy then transition. No % disclosed.
